leo: Quick note — after the maven rollout some tenants saw a sudden negative cache saving on the cost card. Anyone else saw this?
anya: Yup caught it in staging. Prefetch credits didn't seem to map to the new SKU. Dashboard shows a drop.
sam: Sounds like our attribution keys changed (sku fingerprint). We should map old_sku->new_sku on rollout events and expose that to the econ export.
leo: Agreed. UX needs a clear affordance: either annotate the old slab as 'rolled to v2' or draw a rollforward connector. PM prefers the connector.
anya: Connector is clearer. But default to off to avoid confusing customers. Add a tooltip: "Credits rolled forward from previous variant".
sam: Backend plan: add a lightweight rollout payload to the econ stream with from_sku, to_sku, rollout_id, timestamp. We'll also precompute a daily lookup to avoid heavy joins.
leo: Can we also add an alert rule when post-rollout delta < -15% so SRE/PM get pinged?
sam: Yep, add rule to econ-alerts.
devops-bot: infra-bot: rollout-mapping schema PR opened in #pulls (link) — CI passing.
leo: Action items: @sam add rollout payload + daily lookup; @anya mock connector + tooltip and toggle off by default; I'll write a short docs note.
anya: I'll post mock tomorrow.
sam: Will open PR today, estimate 1.5d.
leo: Thanks everyone.
